name: @exploratory-agent/extension
description: Chromium extension: exploratory testing of the current site from a side panel

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f exploratory-agent-extension.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../exploratory-agent-extension.zip . && cd .. && echo 'Wrote packages/extension/exploratory-agent-extension.zip'
scripts.store:assets: npm run build && node --import tsx store/make-assets.ts
scripts.store:video: npm run build && node --import tsx store/make-video.ts
